cards.mood: The piece opens with a solitary, introspective mood that gradually accumulates tension through the verses.
cards.palette: A clean electric guitar with a slight overdrive serves as the harmonic backbone, playing blues-inflected riffs and chord progressions from the Intro through the Outro.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Standing where the iron meets the clay,
The shadows stretch across the dying day.
A heavy crown of dust upon my brow,
I hear the thunder calling out somehow.
[Pre-Chorus]
The pressure builds inside the mountain's chest,
Putting every restless thought to the test.
[Chorus]
Break the seal and let the fire roar,
I don't need to hide anymore.
Crashing like the waves against the stone,
Finding strength in the marrow of my bone.
[Verse]
Grinding gears in the industrial haze,
Walking through the thick and tangled maze.
One spark ignites a forest in the mind,
Leaving every hollow fear behind.
[Pre-Chorus]
The clouds collide in shades of slate and gray,
Chasing all the ghosts of doubt away.
[Chorus]
Break the seal and let the fire roar,
I don't need to hide anymore.
Crashing like the waves against the stone,
Finding strength in the marrow of my bone.
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The ground is shaking beneath my feet,
Where the earth and the heavens meet.
[Chorus]
Break the seal and let the fire roar,
I don't need to hide anymore.
Crashing like the waves against the stone,
Finding strength in the marrow of my bone.
[Outro]
